@copilot AI Prompt
Title: Refactor Connector Protocols to new integration directory
Body:Refactor the changes in this PR to move all Connector-related definitions out of the system directory and into a new top-level directory named integration. The current placement in system is overcrowding that namespace.
Requirements:
1. Create New Directory:
• Create a new directory: packages/spec/src/integration.
2. Move Core Definitions:
• Move packages/spec/src/system/connector.zod.ts (and any related files like authentication, sync configuration, rate limiting schemas) to packages/spec/src/integration/.
• Rename/Structure them appropriately (e.g., packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts).
3. Move Templates:
• Move all specific connector templates (SaaS, Database, File Storage, Message Queue) into the new packages/spec/src/integration directory.
• You may organize them into a subdirectory if appropriate, e.g., packages/spec/src/integration/templates/.
4. Update Exports:
• Update packages/spec/src/index.ts to export the definitions from the new integration directory instead of system.
• Ensure there are no lingering imports referencing the old system paths for these files.
5. Clean Up:
• Remove the connector-related files from packages/spec/src/system to ensure the directory remains focused on system-level configurations only.
Goal: Establish integration as the dedicated namespace for all external system connection protocols.

Completed the refactoring. All connector protocols have been moved to the new `packages/spec/src/integration` directory:

**Changes made:**
- Created new `integration` directory as a dedicated namespace for external system connection protocols
- Moved `connector.zod.ts`, `connector.test.ts`, and all connector templates (saas, database, file-storage, message-queue) from `system` to `integration`
- Created `integration/index.ts` with proper exports
- Updated `system/index.ts` to remove connector exports
- Added `Integration` namespace export to main `index.ts`

**Verification:**
- ✅ All 36 tests passing
- ✅ Build successful with documentation auto-generated for new `integration` category
- ✅ JSON schemas moved to `packages/spec/json-schema/integration/`

The `system` directory is now focused on system-level configurations only, and `integration` is the dedicated namespace for all external system connector protocols.
